name: New FFG Lead to FFG Pre-Sales (Immediate)
trigger_condition: IF lead source is FFG-aligned (FFG website, FFG phone, FFG Google Ads campaign, FFG-aligned referral partner) THEN immediate handoff to FFG pre-sales pipeline
handoff_detail: Zapier/N8N automation creates Ambition lead record and triggers FFG 4-day call cadence. Instant Reply Agent sends acknowledgement within 60 seconds. SDR team picks up via existing FFG pre-sales playbook.
receiving_playbook: FFG Pre-Sales Playbook — 4-day call cadence (Day 1: initial call + SMS + email, Day 2: follow-up call, Day 3: SMS check-in, Day 4: final attempt + voicemail)
polr_during_handoff: POLR record exists but lifecycle is paused. No POLR nurture content sent while lead is in active FFG sales pipeline. POLR tracks status only.
return_trigger: FFG settlement confirmed in Ambition (status = settled) OR lead marked as declined/lost. Settlement triggers Entry Point ffg-settled-client-return. Decline triggers reactivation-ffg-declined after 3-month cooling.
example_scenario: Sarah calls FFG about equipment finance. Within 60 seconds she receives an SMS acknowledgement. Sam Drew's team begins the 4-day call cadence. POLR lifecycle is paused. After settlement, she returns to POLR lifecycle at Month 1.

name: New FHL Lead to FHL Pre-Sales (Immediate)
trigger_condition: IF lead source is FHL-aligned (FHL website, FHL phone, FHL Google Ads campaign, FHL-aligned referral partner) THEN immediate handoff to FHL pre-sales pipeline
handoff_detail: Automation creates Finshaw's lead record and triggers FHL 10-day call cadence. Instant Reply Agent sends acknowledgement within 60 seconds. Bill Robb's team picks up via existing FHL pre-sales playbook.
receiving_playbook: FHL Pre-Sales Playbook — 10-day call cadence (Day 1: initial call + SMS + email, Days 2-3: follow-up calls, Days 4-5: SMS/email nurture, Days 6-8: spaced follow-ups, Days 9-10: final attempts + nurture transition)
polr_during_handoff: POLR record exists but lifecycle is paused. No POLR nurture content sent while lead is in active FHL sales pipeline.
return_trigger: FHL settlement confirmed in Finshaw's CSV export OR lead marked as declined/lost. Settlement triggers fhl-settled-client-return. Decline triggers reactivation-fhl-declined after 3-month cooling.
example_scenario: James enquires about refinancing via the FHL website. Instant Reply Agent responds in 40 seconds. Paige Beveridge begins the 10-day call cadence. POLR lifecycle paused. After settlement, he enters POLR lifecycle at Month 1.

name: POLR Non-Client Signals FFG Intent
trigger_condition: IF person_type = non_client AND (clicked FFG-related content >= 3 times in 30 days OR completed borrowing capacity calculator for vehicle/asset OR directly requested FFG information OR replied to nurture email expressing asset finance need)
handoff_detail: POLR triggers warm introduction: (1) personalised email from POLR introducing FFG team with engagement context, (2) internal task for Sam Drew's team with full POLR engagement summary, (3) SDR calls within 24 hours referencing POLR activity.
receiving_playbook: FFG Pre-Sales Playbook — 4-day call cadence, but SDR has full POLR engagement context (content consumed, time in nurture, ICA assignment, specific interests shown)
polr_during_handoff: POLR reduces frequency to monthly check-in only. Continues property/market updates if relevant. Stops asset finance content to avoid duplicating FFG sales conversation.
return_trigger: FFG settlement: enters POLR lifecycle as dual client. Decline: returns to POLR nurture at previous frequency after 3-month cooling.
example_scenario: Maria signed up to POLR 4 months ago for property insights. She clicks on 3 FFG car finance articles in 2 weeks and uses the vehicle loan calculator. Intent threshold crossed. Personalised email introduces her to Sam Drew. Sam calls next day with full context.

name: POLR Non-Client Signals FHL Intent
trigger_condition: IF person_type = non_client AND (clicked FHL-related content >= 3 times in 30 days OR completed borrowing capacity calculator for property OR engaged with Cotality property valuation tool OR directly requested home loan information)
handoff_detail: POLR triggers warm introduction: (1) personalised email introducing Bill Robb's FHL team with engagement context, (2) internal task for FHL team with full POLR history, (3) broker calls within 24 hours. Cotality data shared if property of interest identified.
receiving_playbook: FHL Pre-Sales Playbook — 10-day call cadence with full POLR engagement context
polr_during_handoff: POLR reduces frequency to monthly. Continues non-home-loan content. Stops home loan content to avoid duplicating FHL conversation.
return_trigger: FHL settlement: enters POLR lifecycle as dual client. Decline: returns to POLR nurture after 3-month cooling.
example_scenario: Josh the renter has been in POLR for 8 months receiving FHB education. He completes the borrowing capacity calculator and checks property valuations in 3 suburbs. Intent threshold crossed. Warm intro connects him with Paige Beveridge with full context.

name: FHL Lifecycle Month 9 — FFG Momentum Pack Handoff
trigger_condition: IF person_type = existing_fhl_client AND lifecycle_month = 9 AND (engaged with FFG Momentum Pack content OR clicked vehicle/asset finance links OR completed asset finance calculator within Momentum Pack)
handoff_detail: Month 9 FFG Momentum Pack is ICA-targeted (5 packs + equity release). If engagement signals asset finance interest: (1) personalised cross-sell email from POLR, (2) internal referral to Sam Drew's team with full client history and ICA, (3) warm call positioned as 'your Fox family helping with your next step'.
receiving_playbook: FFG Pre-Sales Playbook — modified cadence for existing FHL clients. Shorter qualification (already a Fox client with known profile).
polr_during_handoff: POLR lifecycle continues normally for FHL touchpoints (Month 12, 15, 18). FFG transaction runs in parallel. POLR sends no asset finance content while FFG pipeline is active.
return_trigger: FFG settlement: client becomes dual-entity in POLR. If FFG declines: no cooling period needed (existing FHL client), returns to FHL-only lifecycle.
example_scenario: Angela settled her home loan 9 months ago. She receives the ICA-targeted FFG Momentum Pack showing how her equity could fund a new car. She clicks the car finance calculator. Internal referral created for Andrew Glen.

name: FFG Lifecycle — Homeowner Detected, FHL Handoff
trigger_condition: IF person_type = existing_ffg_client AND (lifecycle_month IN [6, 9] OR property_ownership_detected = true) AND (property_owner_flag = true OR engaged with refinance/property content OR self-declared homeowner in survey)
handoff_detail: When FFG lifecycle identifies a homeowner: (1) POLR sends personalised property insight content (Cotality valuation if address known), (2) if engagement positive, internal referral to Bill Robb's FHL team, (3) warm intro positioned as property health check.
receiving_playbook: FHL Pre-Sales Playbook — modified cadence for existing FFG clients. Positioned as complimentary property review for Fox family members.
polr_during_handoff: POLR FFG lifecycle continues normally. FHL transaction runs in parallel. Property-specific content paused while FHL pipeline active.
return_trigger: FHL settlement: client becomes dual-entity in POLR. If FHL declines: no cooling period, returns to FFG-only lifecycle.
example_scenario: Brad settled a $50K equipment loan 6 months ago. During a POLR engagement survey he indicates he owns a home with a $480K mortgage at ANZ. POLR sends him a free Cotality valuation showing his property has grown 12%. He clicks to learn more. Internal referral to Bill Robb.

name: FFG Client Business Growth — FHL Commercial Handoff
trigger_condition: IF person_type = existing_ffg_client AND ica_confirmed IN [business_asset] AND (repeat_business_loan_count >= 2 OR total_business_finance > $200K OR engaged with commercial property content OR self-declared business expansion plans)
handoff_detail: Business growth pattern detected in ICA 4 clients. POLR triggers: (1) commercial property/business lending content, (2) if engaged, internal referral to FHL commercial team, (3) warm introduction positioned as helping the business take the next step.
receiving_playbook: FHL Pre-Sales Playbook — commercial lending pathway. Bill Robb or designated commercial broker receives with full FFG loan history.
polr_during_handoff: POLR FFG lifecycle continues. Commercial lending transaction runs in parallel.
return_trigger: FHL commercial settlement: client becomes dual-entity. If declined: returns to FFG-only lifecycle, no cooling period.
example_scenario: Mason's landscaping business has financed 3 trucks through FFG over 18 months ($180K total). POLR detects the growth pattern. He receives content about commercial property for growing businesses. He engages. Internal referral to Bill Robb.

name: FHL Client Needs Vehicle or Equipment — FFG Handoff
trigger_condition: IF person_type = existing_fhl_client AND (engaged with FFG content >= 2 times in 30 days OR clicked vehicle/equipment finance links OR completed asset finance calculator OR self-declared vehicle/equipment need)
handoff_detail: FHL client showing asset finance interest outside of Month 9 Momentum Pack. POLR triggers: (1) targeted asset finance content based on ICA, (2) if engaged, warm intro to FFG team, (3) positioned as one Fox family benefit.
receiving_playbook: FFG Pre-Sales Playbook — warm referral cadence for existing FHL clients. Shorter qualification. Sam Drew or Andrew Glen receives based on asset type.
polr_during_handoff: POLR FHL lifecycle continues normally. Asset finance content paused while FFG pipeline active.
return_trigger: FFG settlement: client becomes dual-entity. If declined: no cooling period, returns to FHL-only lifecycle.
example_scenario: Rachel settled her home loan 14 months ago. She clicks on an FFG car finance article in a POLR email and then uses the vehicle loan calculator. Intent threshold crossed. Warm intro to Bradley Robb.

name: FFG Settlement Complete — Return to POLR Lifecycle
trigger_condition: IF ffg_pipeline_status = settled AND settlement_date IS NOT NULL THEN activate POLR lifecycle Month 1
handoff_detail: Ambition settlement event triggers automated POLR lifecycle activation: (1) ICA confirmed from settlement data, (2) FHL Purchase Type mapping applied, (3) Month 1 Welcome touchpoint scheduled, (4) 18-month lifecycle cadence initiated.
receiving_playbook: POLR Lifecycle Playbook — FFG client pathway. Month 1/3/6/9/12/15/18 touchpoints. Cross-sell targeting based on ICA-to-FHL-Purchase-Type mapping.
polr_during_handoff: N/A — this IS the return to POLR. POLR lifecycle becomes the primary engagement channel.
return_trigger: N/A — this is the return event itself. Future handoffs may occur at lifecycle touchpoints when intent signals detected.
example_scenario: Tom's truck loan settles. Ambition API fires settlement webhook. POLR automatically confirms ICA 4 (Business Asset), maps to FHL Commercial Purchase Type, schedules Month 1 welcome call, initiates lifecycle.

name: FHL Settlement Complete — Return to POLR Lifecycle
trigger_condition: IF fhl_pipeline_status = settled AND settlement_date IS NOT NULL THEN activate POLR lifecycle Month 1
handoff_detail: Finshaw's CSV settlement export (weekly, manual) triggers POLR lifecycle activation: (1) ICA confirmed from FHL Purchase Type, (2) Cotality property tracking activated, (3) Month 1 Welcome touchpoint scheduled, (4) 18-month lifecycle cadence initiated. Note: weekly CSV lag means up to 7-day delay.
receiving_playbook: POLR Lifecycle Playbook — FHL client pathway. 7 confirmed touchpoints: Month 1/3/6/9/12/15/18. FFG cross-sell targeting active throughout.
polr_during_handoff: N/A — this IS the return to POLR.
return_trigger: N/A — this is the return event itself.
example_scenario: Lisa's home loan settles Tuesday. Friday's Finshaw's CSV export captures it. POLR automation processes the CSV: confirms ICA from FHL Purchase Type (FHB), activates Cotality tracking, schedules Month 1 welcome call with Paige.

name: Declined Lead — 3-Month Cooling, Re-enters POLR
direction_note: Also applies to fhl_return_to_polr — direction depends on which business declined
trigger_condition: IF (ffg_pipeline_status = declined OR fhl_pipeline_status = declined) AND days_since_decline >= 90 AND lead_has_not_opted_out = true THEN re-enter POLR value journey as reactivation lead
handoff_detail: After 90-day cooling period: (1) soft re-introduction email (education-first, not sales), (2) if declined for credit, flag UMI as potential pathway, (3) progressive re-engagement — content first, then tools, then warm intro only when intent signals detected.
receiving_playbook: POLR Reactivation Playbook — softer cadence than new leads. Monthly education for 3 months, then standard non-client nurture if engaged.
polr_during_handoff: N/A — this IS the re-entry to POLR. Zero contact during 90-day cooling period.
return_trigger: N/A — this is the return event. Future handoffs via intent signal detection (same as handoff points polr-nonclient-ffg-intent and polr-nonclient-fhl-intent).
example_scenario: Dave was declined by FFG for a car loan 3 months ago. POLR triggers: sends 'Financial Fresh Start' email with credit improvement tips. No mention of decline. Over 2 months he engages and uses credit score checker. Intent signal triggers warm FFG re-introduction.

name: POLR Non-Client Converts — Books Call or Requests Quote
direction_note: Dynamic — polr_to_ffg or polr_to_fhl depending on action taken
trigger_condition: IF person_type = non_client AND (booked_call = true OR requested_quote = true OR completed_application_form = true OR replied_to_nurture_requesting_conversation = true)
handoff_detail: Non-client takes explicit conversion action: (1) if self-service booking, confirmation triggers pre-call sequence with identity framing, (2) if quote request, routes to appropriate business based on service type, (3) full POLR engagement history attached to handoff.
receiving_playbook: FFG Pre-Sales (if asset finance) or FHL Pre-Sales (if home lending). Modified warm approach — this person has been nurtured by POLR and is self-qualifying.
polr_during_handoff: POLR pauses nurture content. Sends pre-call sequence only. Resumes lifecycle after settlement or decline.
return_trigger: Settlement: enters POLR lifecycle as new client. Decline: 3-month cooling then re-enters POLR nurture. Withdrew/ghosted: returns to POLR nurture immediately at reduced frequency.
example_scenario: Maria has been in POLR for 6 months. She clicks 'Book a Free Car Finance Chat'. Calendar booking confirmed. Pre-call sequence sent. Sam Drew receives her full POLR history before the call: 6 months of engagement, 12 emails opened, used calculator twice, ICA 5.
